intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Tavri holds up an official program. Under her name, it says *effortlessly delightful.*

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Effortlessly. Adorable. It took the clerk three drafts to spell it.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Draft one said *effortlessly delighful.* I liked that one. It had a flaw in it.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “To something with room for a bad day? ‘Usually delightful.’ ‘Delightful, terms apply.’”

options.labelText: “Print draft one. The typo’s the most honest word on it.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “A flaw, in print, on purpose. The clerk will faint.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She circles the missing *t* and initials it.

options.labelText: “Keep it. People like knowing what they’re getting.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “I’ll schedule my bad days for when the program’s out of print.”
